s:

3. The Chief Ministers of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana are its members.

x: The Apex Council has three members: the Union Minister of Water Resources as Chairperson and the Chief Ministers of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana as members.

s: Which one of the following is NOT a function of the Apex Council under Section 84(3) of the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014?
o: Referring disputes not covered by KWDT to a tribunal under the ISRWD Act, 1956
Allocating or redetermining the shares of the States in river waters
Approving new projects on the Krishna and Godavari after appraisal by the Board and the CWC
Supervising the Krishna and Godavari River Management Boards
x: The Apex Council can supervise the Boards, approve new projects after appraisal, settle disputes by negotiation and refer certain disputes to a tribunal. Allocation or redetermination of shares is not stated as its function here.
tq: Separate the power to approve projects and settle disputes from the power to allocate water shares.

s: The power to approve a new project on the Krishna or Godavari, after appraisal by the concerned Board and the Central Water Commission, belongs to which body?

The Godavari River Management Board alone

s: Which of the following correctly describes the role of the Apex Council in relation to disputes?

It permanently reallocates all river-water shares without reference to any tribunal.
It refers every dispute directly to the Supreme Court without negotiation.
It deals only with disputes concerning the Tungabhadra River.
x: The Apex Council is empowered to settle disputes through negotiation and to refer disputes not covered by KWDT to a tribunal under the Inter-State River Water Disputes Act, 1956.

s:

1. Clause (1) concerns parliamentary provision for adjudicating inter-State river disputes.
2. Clause (2) permits Parliament to bar the jurisdiction of the Supreme Court and other courts over such disputes.
